question: Show that the de Broglie standing wave condition for an electron in a circular orbit leads to the quantisation of angular momentum.

options.D: For a stationary wave, $2\pi r=n\lambda$. With $\lambda=\dfrac{h}{mv}$, $2\pi r=n\dfrac{h}{mv}$, so $2\pi mvr=nh$ and $mvr=\dfrac{nh}{2\pi}$.
